title: Open Balance of a Specialty Pharmacy Program Enrollment
content:
**Definition.** Under the Specialty Pharmacy Program, an enrollment's open balance is determined from its ledger:

- When the enrollment's ledger shows shipped fills, the open balance is the total cost share of every shipped fill, less every payment posted on the enrollment by the member, a manufacturer program or a foundation, less the cost share set aside for fills settled at the outside pharmacy that dispensed them.
- When it shows no shipped fill but shows scheduled fills, the open balance is zero, because nothing has been charged yet.
- Otherwise the open balance is the balance due shown on the enrollment.

## Ladder

| Ledger shows | Open balance |
|---|---|
| one or more shipped fills | total cost share of all shipped fills, less all payments posted on the enrollment from any payer, less the cost share set aside for outside-dispensed fills |
| no shipped fill, but one or more scheduled fills | zero |
| neither shipped nor scheduled fills | the balance due shown on the enrollment |

## Worked cases (assumed figures)

**Shipped fills present.**

| Item | Figure |
|---|---|
| Cost share of shipped fills: $400.00, $350.00 and $150.00 | $900.00 total |
| Payments posted: member $200.00 and manufacturer program $300.00 | $500.00 total |
| Cost share set aside for outside-dispensed fills | $0.00 |
| **Open balance** | **$400.00** |

If $150.00 of that cost share were set aside for a fill settled at the outside pharmacy that dispensed it, the open balance would be $250.00.

**Only scheduled fills.** The open balance is $0.00, whatever balance due is shown.

**No fills on the ledger.** The open balance is the balance due shown, for example $75.00.
